decision.explanation: The question asks which educational institution Ting-Chang Hsieh attended. Document D1S3 explicitly states that 'it all began during his formative years at the Université de Montréal,' and other supporting quotes (D1S4, D1S5) reinforce that this was his educational institution. The second candidate, Linkou Chang Gung Memorial Hospital (C1), is described in document d2 as a professional collaborator and affiliated organization, not an educational institution. Therefore, only 'Université de Montréal' satisfies the requested relation and answer type.
